item.title: Trump Administration Looks to Ramp Up Flying Taxis
item.description: As China makes more advances on flying taxis, the Trump administration is hoping it can speed up the U.S. effort. The biggest startups hope for a 2026 debut.

item.title: Delta President Glen Hauenstein to Retire After Leading Premium Push
item.description: Hauenstein played a pivotal role in Delta’s premium push, which has made Delta one of the most profitable airlines in the U.S.

item.title: How Live Tourism Fueled India’s Travel Industry This Year
item.description: What started as revenge travel post Covid has now changed into Indians taking every event and turning into an opportunity to travel.

item.title: How Travel Leaders Turn Skift Megatrends Into Winning 2026 Strategies
item.description: Each January, travel leaders face the same question: which signals matter enough to act on? Skift Megatrends arrive at the perfect moment, giving teams a preview of the forces that will influence demand, competition, and consumer behavior in the coming year.

item.title: AI Is Reshaping Luxury Travel Discovery — Here’s What Marketers Must Do
item.description: Luxury travel discovery is being rewritten by large language models — and PR has become performance marketing for machines, not just people. Brands still optimizing for yesterday’s gatekeepers risk disappearing from tomorrow’s consideration set.

item.title: Luxury Hotel Race: How the Biggest Groups Stack Up
item.description: Everyone wants the luxury traveler, but no two hotel groups define “luxury” the same way. From yachts to boutique collections to loyalty tie-ins, hotel giants are rewriting the rules to win the richest guests in a race that keeps getting bigger.

item.title: House Committee Backs Bill to Shield Air Traffic Control From Shutdown Chaos
item.description: If the bill passes Congress, it would remove a major bargaining chip that resulted in the end of the two longest government shutdowns in U.S. history.

item.title: American Airlines No Longer Lets Customers Earn Miles on Basic Economy
item.description: The policy is another sign that the economy is skewing toward the wealthy and away from the Middle Class.

item.title: No Vote on NYC Bill to Ease Short-Term Rental Rules
item.description: A change is possible, but for now prospects for altering New York City's quasi ban of short-term rentals look darker than an alleyway in the Bowery.

item.title: OpenAI Breaks Open ChatGPT App Submissions
item.description: Any travel brand can now submit apps and get listed in its new app store — which means Booking.com and Expedia, early movers in OpenAI’s app ecosystem, will soon get new competition to own ChatGPT’s travel conversations.
